$values.Text: Prepares the equipment. Set the cooling temperature for your camera; connect the equipment before you start the sequence.

Requires the NSTN plugin 0.7.0 or later and the SQM value of your site in Options > Plugins > NSTN. Set your target here (name search, Framing or Sky Atlas). The filter names in the NSTN filter plan must match the filter wheel list of your profile: pick yours in each row. NSTN Night Info shows the night and checks the setup.
Runs once the filter plan has ended: no NSTN window opens again tonight.
